summary.ru: (+) have / has been + V-ing · (–) have / has not been + V-ing · (?) Have / Has + … + been + V-ing?
summary.en: (+) have / has been + V-ing · (–) have / has not been + V-ing · (?) Have / Has + … + been + V-ing?

body.ru:
(+) **S + have/has been + V-ing**
(–) **S + have/has not been + V-ing**
(?) **Have/Has + S + been + V-ing?**
I / you / we / they → **have**; he / she / it → **has**
body.en:
(+) **S + have/has been + V-ing**
(–) **S + have/has not been + V-ing**
(?) **Have/Has + S + been + V-ing?**
I / you / we / they → **have**; he / she / it → **has**

examples: I have been reading all evening.
She has been working since morning.
They have not been sleeping well.

body.ru:
• действие началось в прошлом и **длится до сих пор**
• важен **процесс**, а не результат
• виден **результат** недавнего действия
• действие **повторялось** до настоящего момента
• ответ на вопрос **how long**
body.en:
• the action started in the past and is **still going on**
• the **process** matters, not the result
• the **result** of a recent action is visible
• the action has **repeated** up to now
• it answers the question **how long**

examples: The ground is wet because it has been raining.
You look tired — have you been working all day?
It has been raining all morning.

body.ru:
• **for** (в течение) + длительность
• **since** (с) + начало
• **how long** (как долго)
• **lately / recently** (в последнее время)
• **all day / all morning** (весь день / всё утро)
• **this week** (на этой неделе)
body.en:
• **for** + duration
• **since** + starting point
• **how long**
• **lately / recently**
• **all day / all morning**
• **this week**

examples: How long have you been learning English?

questions.sentence: The bus is still not here, and I ___ for it for twenty minutes.

translation.ru: Автобуса всё ещё нет, а я жду его уже двадцать минут.

explanation.ru: Действие началось двадцать минут назад и продолжается сейчас, поэтому нужна форма have been waiting.
explanation.en: The action started twenty minutes ago and is still going on, so have been waiting is correct.

translation.ru: Она работает в этом офисе с 2021 года.

explanation.ru: Since 2021 указывает на точку отсчёта, а действие продолжается — нужен Present Perfect Continuous с has.
explanation.en: Since 2021 gives a starting point and the action continues, so the Present Perfect Continuous with has is needed.

explanation.en: The action has lasted all day and is still going on, so has been raining is correct.

prompt.en: Match the form with its example.

left.ru: I / you / we / they: have been + -ing (с этими местоимениями)
left.en: I / you / we / they: have been + -ing

pairs.right: I have been waiting for an hour.

left.ru: he / she / it: has been + -ing (с этими местоимениями)

explanation.ru: Have используется с I, you, we и they, has — с he, she и it; отрицание и вопрос строятся с have/has + been + -ing.
explanation.en: Have goes with I, you, we and they, has with he, she and it; the negative and question use have/has + been + -ing.

prompt.en: Match the duration with its example.

pairs.right: I have been writing emails for two hours.
He has been living here since 2020.
It has been raining all day.
How long have they been waiting?

explanation.ru: For называет длительность, since — начало, all day подчёркивает весь период, а how long спрашивает о длительности.
explanation.en: For gives duration, since gives the starting point, all day stresses the whole period, and how long asks about duration.

prompt.en: Match the type of action with its example.

pairs.right: He has been learning Chinese since last year.
Someone has been ringing the doorbell for ten minutes.
They have been washing the car.
He is tired because he has been running.

explanation.ru: Время показывает действие, которое продолжается, повторяется или только что закончилось с видимым результатом.
explanation.en: The tense shows an action that continues, repeats or has just stopped with a visible result.

prompt.ru: Сопоставьте глагол и форму в Present Perfect Continuous.
prompt.en: Match the verb with its form in the Present Perfect Continuous.

pairs.right: She has been studying all evening.
They have been running in the park.
He has been writing a report.
I have been sitting here for an hour.

explanation.ru: Форма всегда have/has been + V-ing, поэтому у всех глаголов появляется -ing.
explanation.en: The form is always have/has been + V-ing, so every verb takes -ing.

prompt.en: Match the mistake with the correct example.

pairs.right: I have known him for years.
She has been going to the gym.

left.ru: Ошибка: *We have waiting for an hour* →

pairs.right: We have been waiting for half an hour.
He has been working here since May.

explanation.ru: После have/has обязательно идёт been: **has been going**, **have been waiting**; с глаголами состояния форма -ing не используется.
explanation.en: After have/has the word been is required: **has been going**, **have been waiting**; state verbs do not take the -ing form.

prompt.en: Match the question with its example.

pairs.right: How long have you been living here?
What have you been doing all day?
Why have you been crying?
Have you been sleeping well?

explanation.ru: Вопрос строится с Have/Has + … + been + V-ing; вопросительное слово ставится в начало.
explanation.en: The question is built with Have/Has + … + been + V-ing; the question word comes first.
